blurb: Guests cruise the turquoise waters of the Florida Keys on handcrafted floating tiki bars. They can enjoy music, drinks, and island vibes while spotting wildlife like dolphins and manatees. Tours range from sunrise serenity to sunset celebrations, with options for private charters and group cruises.

quotes.author: Glenn Saltsman
quotes.text: Glenn Saltsman Wow!!! What an amazing time we had, beautiful scenery and some awesome music!!! We'll come back and do it again!! The captain was informative. Susie Snavley The cruise was fantastic. Captain Chris and host Lori were very knowledgeable of the area and the surrounding is beautiful. A must do when in the Key Largo area Sandy Saltsman Captain Chris was a great tour guide. Since it was windy we took a awesome tour of the canals and restaurants. Would highly recommend this to all ages. Sunset cruises are wonderful, but he'll accommodate any special requests.
